SELECT DISTINCT ea.approval_id AS weeklyId, ea.drafter_id AS employeeId, fd.start_dt AS startDate, fd.end_dt AS endDate, CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN ea.approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS approvalStatus, DATE(fd.start_dt) AS planDate, '유연근무' AS workForm, ea.title AS scheduleTitle, fd.reason AS memo, ( SELECT al2.reason FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al2.approval_status IN ('REJECTED', 'HOLD') AND al2.reason IS NOT NULL AND al2.reason <> '' ORDER BY al2.approved_dt DESC, al2.approval_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS rejectReason, ea.drafter_name AS employeeName, ea.department_name AS departmentName, '직원' AS positionName, ea.draft_dt AS createdAt, ea.approve_dt AS updatedAt FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id JOIN flexible_work_detail fd ON fd.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE
ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ea.approval_id) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id JOIN flexible_work_detail fd ON fd.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE
SELECT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.drafter_id AS employeeId, ea.title AS scheduleTitle FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE ea.approval_id = #{approvalId} AND ea.doc_type = 'FLEXIBLE'
